source: Root collaboration report; these runtime actions were executed by root, not the effects agent.

tests.name: actual-client-streamed-subset-and-navigation-attempt
tests.reportedResult: Player2 initially had 2351 received map descendants / 1424 collision descendants versus Server 30726. A character_navigation attempt returned ToolSuccess; no before/after character position delta was recorded.
tests.correction: Root withdrew the earlier 16-stud movement claim after observing that the navigation tool can return Success without arriving. This attempt is not a verified movement distance or genuine WASD input pass.

tests.name: actual-death-and-spectating-pipeline
tests.trigger: Root set actual Player1 Humanoid.Health=0; runtime death pipeline.
tests.reportedResult: Automatic/scriptable camera followed Player2; RoundStatus spectatetarget -2 accepted, SpectatorCount=1.

tests.name: actual-distant-spectator-streaming
tests.trigger: Root relocated actual Player2 about 925 studs to P2_01 after floor query and RequestStreamAroundAsync.

reportedResult.console: No SpectateStreaming errors reported by root.

tests.name: actual-normal-mid-round-leave
tests.trigger: Root sent current ordinary RoundStatus leaveround request for Player2, then Player1.
tests.reportedResult: Player2 returned alive to lobby, InRound=false and SpectatorCount cleared. Afterwards both health100/InRound=false/RoundActive=false. Cached map presence was not interpreted as active gameplay.

limitations.note: Current public authored L2 adapter bypasses old pump/entity controllers. Forced death/runtime relocation validate those live pipelines, not hostile gameplay or natural traversal of the whole route.
